review.why: A brief-led visual design process with explicit critique, typography, content and restrained interaction guidance.
review.summary: Strong complement to a searchable UI reference: it starts with the subject and audience, develops tokens and layout, then critiques the result. Concrete quality principles, without a reusable implementation library.
strengths: Brief takes precedence over aesthetic defaults
Includes responsive, focus and reduced-motion expectations
Connects interface copy to user actions
cautions: No automated accessibility or browser verification supplied
